page.notes: Hebrew words and vowel points are copied from a low-resolution scan; most Hebrew forms are uncertain and marked [?]. The Latin "qum" at the head of the first entry may be "cum" with a stroke; marked [?]. The bare letter "א" at the top of the right column is a section letter, given as a paragraph. The "spon-" at the foot right is a catchword. The Hebrew running head letters are uncertain. Several Hebrew entries are partly blurred and their vowel points are not fully legible.
